title: P1 Architect: normalize and complete security and robustness specification signals
body: Separate specification work. Review normalized threat-model, PII registry, RBAC invariant and robustness/error-semantics predicates against all canonical document roots and actual domain contracts. Distinguish differently named existing prose from genuinely missing requirements. Record consequential security/domain decisions in the approved governance workflow; never invent legal rules or alter thresholds to get PASS.
